## The claim

P4-13: NT-v2, a DNA language model that reads the nonsense allele as well as the missense one, ranks the confirmed pair in the top decile of its own pair ranking

**Prediction if true.** the ntv2 lane scores both confirmed alleles and its catalogue-free rank of the confirmed pair is at or under the 10th percentile

**What would refute it.** the lane abstains on either confirmed allele, or the pair sits above the median (50th percentile) of the lane's ranking
